name: com.reviewsdataapi/x402-trustpilot-yelp-google-reviews-mcp
title: ReviewsDataAPI — Trustpilot, Yelp, Google & Glassdoor Reviews MCP. Zero-signu
description: Trustpilot, Yelp, Google & Glassdoor Reviews MCP. Zero-signup x402 USDC ($0.0015) on Base or key.

tools.name: trustpilot_reviews
tools.description: Fetch verified Trustpilot customer reviews for any company domain (e.g. "printful.com" or "shopify.com"), complete with 1–5 star distribution histogram, aspect sentiment polarities, reviewer country/verification level, and company replies. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits if empty).

domain.description: Company website domain or Trustpilot URL, e.g. "printful.com", "wise.com", or "https://www.trustpilot.com/review/printful.com".

page.description: Page number (1-indexed, up to 20 reviews per page).

limit.description: Maximum reviews to return (1–20 per page).

tools.name: trustpilot_company
tools.description: Retrieve a company TrustScore, star rating, total verified reviews, 12-month review velocity, claimed/verified status, categories, and business contact info on Trustpilot. Cost: 10 Credits / company profile.

tools.name: yelp_search
tools.description: Search Yelp local businesses by keyword and city/location (e.g. query="coffee", location="Austin, TX") and retrieve Yelp business_id, alias, unrounded star rating, review count, price level, phone, address, and coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / business returned.

query.description: Search keyword or category, e.g. "specialty coffee", "ramen", or "emergency plumber".

location.description: City, neighborhood, postal code, or address, e.g. "Austin, TX" or "Brooklyn, NY".

tools.name: yelp_reviews
tools.description: Retrieve full-text Yelp customer reviews, star distribution, sentiment polarity breakdown, useful/funny/cool votes, and owner replies by Yelp business_id, alias, or yelp.com/biz URL (bypasses the official Yelp Fusion 3-review cap). Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

business_id.description: Yelp business_id (e.g. "p88l_DLOIB-yL3Ka8GbGDw"), slug alias (e.g. "desnudo-coffee-austin-2"), or full yelp.com/biz/... URL.

tools.name: tripadvisor_search
tools.description: Search TripAdvisor destinations, cities, hotels, attractions, and restaurants by query (e.g. "Paris" or "Santorini hotels") to obtain geo_id / location_id, ratings, review counts, and coordinates. Cost: 5 Credits / location returned.

query.description: Destination, hotel, attraction, or restaurant name, e.g. "Paris" or "Tokyo Shibuya".

tools.name: tripadvisor_restaurants
tools.description: Retrieve ranked TripAdvisor restaurants for a destination geo_id (e.g. "187147" for Paris), including bubble rating, total reviews, popularity rank, price range, cuisines, neighborhood, and Travellers Choice badges. Cost: 5 Credits / restaurant returned.

geo_id.description: Numeric TripAdvisor geo_id / location_id (e.g. "187147" for Paris, "60763" for New York City).

tools.name: google_play_reviews
tools.description: Fetch real-time Google Play Store customer reviews for any Android app package ID (e.g. "com.spotify.music" or "com.openai.chatgpt"), including star histogram, aspect sentiment polarities, app_version, thumbs-up votes, and developer replies. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

app_id.description: Android package ID or Play Store URL, e.g. "com.spotify.music", "com.duolingo", or "com.notion.id".

tools.name: app_store_reviews
tools.description: Fetch real-time Apple App Store customer reviews for any iOS/macOS app numeric ID (e.g. "324684580" for Spotify or "6448311069" for ChatGPT) across 175+ countries, including star distribution, sentiment polarity, app_version, and helpfulness votes. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned.

app_id.description: Numeric Apple App Store ID or apps.apple.com URL, e.g. "324684580" or "https://apps.apple.com/us/app/spotify/id324684580".

country.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 App Store storefront country (e.g. "us", "gb", "ca", "au", "jp").

page.description: Feed page (1–10, up to 50 reviews per page).

tools.name: glassdoor_companies
tools.description: Search Glassdoor employer profiles by company name or domain (e.g. "Printful", "Stripe", "Notion") and retrieve numeric company_id, overall rating, total review/salary/job counts, CEO approval rate, recommend-to-friend rate, business outlook, and 6 workplace sub-ratings (work-life balance, culture, career opportunities, compensation, senior management, diversity). Cost: 5 Credits / company returned (0 Credits if empty).

query.description: Employer or company name to search on Glassdoor, e.g. "Printful", "Shopify", or "Cloudflare".

limit.description: Maximum matching employer profiles to return (1–50).

tools.name: glassdoor_reviews
tools.description: Fetch Glassdoor employee & employer reviews by numeric company_id (e.g. "1001330" for Printful) OR by company name query (auto-resolves company_id first), including Pros, Cons, Advice to Management, job title, current/former employee status, workplace sub-ratings, 1–5 star distribution histogram, and aspect sentiment polarities. Cost: 2 Credits / review returned (0 Credits if empty).

company_id.description: Numeric Glassdoor company_id (e.g. "1001330" for Printful) or Glassdoor company URL. Optional if query is provided.

query.description: Company name (e.g. "Printful") — if company_id is omitted, automatically searches Glassdoor to resolve company_id first.
